text.p: Tropical Storm Abel is expected to make landfall west of Hong Kong in about 24 hours. Top winds may be near 55 mph. The main threat from this storm will be heavy rainfall which may result in some flooding.

Tropical Depression 31W is moving southwestward and is expected to turn west northwestward, passing close to Guam in about 60 hours. This system may become a strong tropical storm before moving near Guam.
Tropical Depression 32W is expected to move westward across Luzon, Philippines within 60 hours as a strong tropical storm. Flooding may result. This system may be stronger by that time.
THERE ARE NO FURTHER EMERGENCY WEATHER STATEMENTS
